name: LootboxTypeGradeWeight - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: A box-grade weight for one lootbox type: how often boxes of that type spawn at one grade. Created from the type's Grade weights step (Create New Join Entry).

steps.description: Replaces one grade's own drop chance in this type's box-grade roll. Grades without an entry keep their drop chance.

fields.label: Box grade
fields.description: Only grades between the type's minimum and maximum box grade are rolled; an entry outside that range has no effect. One entry per grade.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Relative weight (0 or more) against the other grades' weights or drop chances, e.g. Legendary's default is 15. 0 = this type never spawns at this grade.
